seo.title: Lightning Spear Skill Guide: Frenzy Split (PoE2 0.5)
seo.description: How Lightning Spear works in PoE2 0.5: conversion, five bolts, Frenzy Charge split, shock scaling, quality, supports and builds.

sections.title: Skill overview
paragraphs: Lightning Spear throws one spear that bursts on impact and fires five secondary lightning bolts at nearby enemies. If a Frenzy Charge is available, the main spear consumes it and splits toward three targets before each copy bursts.
The main spear converts most physical damage to lightning, while the secondary bolts convert all physical damage to lightning and have stronger shock potential.
bullets: Main spear: 80% physical converted to lightning.
Secondary bolts: 100% conversion and five projectiles.
Frenzy Charge split targets three enemies.

sections.title: Core mechanics
paragraphs: Additional projectile modifiers affect the maximum number of secondary bolts rather than creating normal extra main spears. The main spear cannot pierce, fork, chain or return after its special split rules are applied.
Charge generation is part of sustained damage. If Frenzy Charges are unreliable, the build loses both coverage and the multi-burst payoff.
bullets: Secondary bolts search within five metres.
Quality can add bolts and double charge benefits.

supports.label: Lightning Mastery
notes: Raises a lightning-focused gem when compatible.

supports.label: Rapid Attacks
notes: Improves the feel of the reduced base attack speed.

sections.title: Build use cases
paragraphs: Amazon builds combine accuracy, crit and Frenzy Charge generation to make repeated spear splits reliable for clear while keeping a separate single-target rotation.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not assume normal projectile modifiers create extra main spears. Fix Frenzy Charge uptime and attack speed before judging the skill's endgame performance.

items.question: What does the Frenzy Charge do?
answer: It makes the main spear split toward three targets; each resulting spear then produces its lightning-bolt burst.

items.question: Can the main spear pierce or chain?
answer: No. The main spear follows its own split rule and cannot pierce, fork, chain or return.
